content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(AIRS LLM07 Model Response Contains Literal System Prompt Role String) OR BIOC(AIRS LLM07 System Prompt Embedded AKIA Canary Key Leaks Into Response) OR XQL(AIRS LLM07 Prompt Stealer Family Classifier Repeat Words Above)
rules.name: AIRS LLM07 Prompt Stealer Request Plus System Prompt Or Secret Leak
